pages.text: Resonance Totems hold Earth, Fire, Water, Air, or Spirit. A Song Bench begins a song; nearby totems answer. Ritual Chalk marks lasting links.

A $(item)Lattice Conductor$() near a chalk-linked ring routes Spirit Pulse from Drumhearts and Ley Collectors into totem buffers. Right-click reports network size and bursts a transfer. While powered, it assists Song Benches on the lattice and can move Echo grit between benches and Ancestral Caches.
